de: Born at Iconium, she was named after the day of the Passion (Paraskeve is Greek for 'Friday'). Orphaned early, she vowed virginity and preached among the pagans. Under Diocletian she refused to worship the idols, was tortured and beheaded.

de: Trained at the Trinity Lavra, a preacher and theologian, he was rector of the St Petersburg Theological Academy and from 1821 Metropolitan of Moscow. He played a central part in the translation of the Bible into Russian, composed the Christian Catechism and drafted the 1861 Manifesto emancipating the serfs. He was glorified by the Council of Bishops of 1994.

de: Ти був, блаженний Олександре, чесною галуззю благочестивого кореня, бо Христос явив тебе як божественний скарб Руської землі, нового чудотворця, преславного і Богові угодного.
